title: Buck2CargoTargetCoverage
description: Local/static AC-0.13 contract for measuring Cargo workspace target roots against Buck2 rust crate_root mappings. This is target-coverage/divergence evidence, not source-line coverage and not live cloud-ci authority.

_meta.source_request: Founder directive 2026-06-03: preserve dual Cargo+Buck2 Rust ergonomics while keeping Buck2 as CI/build/test authority.

official_references.name: Cargo Book — Workspaces
official_references.used_for: Cargo.toml workspace membership, glob membership, and exclude boundary.

official_references.name: Cargo Book — Cargo Targets
official_references.used_for: Cargo lib/bin target-root discovery including [lib], [[bin]], src/lib.rs, src/main.rs, src/bin/*.rs, src/bin/*/main.rs, and auto* discovery flags.

official_references.name: Buck2 — Commands
official_references.used_for: Buck2 target-based evidence and Build ID capture.

official_references.name: Buck2 — Bootstrapping
official_references.used_for: Dual Cargo/Buck2 and reindeer-generated Buck graph context.

official_references.name: Reindeer
official_references.used_for: Rust crate import and generated Buck rule context for monorepo crate graphs.

cargo_target_roots: src/main.rs when autobins discovery is enabled
src/bin/*.rs when autobins discovery is enabled
src/bin/*/main.rs when autobins discovery is enabled
measurement_contract.cargo_autodiscovery_rule: Respect Cargo package auto-discovery flags for lib/bin targets: autolib/autobins=false disables implicit roots; 2015-edition packages with any manually defined target default implicit discovery to false; newer editions default implicit discovery to true.
measurement_contract.buck2_mapping_rule: A Cargo target root is covered when a checked-in BUCK file has crate_root resolving to that same source path.
forbidden_authority: Cargo target discovery as CI/build/test authority
source-line coverage claims from this target-coverage gate
candidate-authored divergence omissions as Phase-0 green authority
local/static output as protected branch authority
measurement_contract.buck2_execution_boundary: Whole-repo scanner target runs repo_relative_root=true, remote=false, cacheable=false because Cargo/BUCK discovery spans package boundaries; this is local/static measurement, not hermetic remote-execution proof.
